OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalised telephone concatenated with its
                lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the owner's customerCode, processed
                right-to-left with every second digit doubled.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Set
                when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an
                existing owner has the same lastName and address; both owners
                are then assigned this identifier.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d-372b-3f4a-8b4a-1d2c3e4f5a6b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation: starting at 1, add 1 when an email is present and add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, read from the '<REGION>' component
                of its region-and-hash customerCode (the region derived from the
                owner's postcode, falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. A
                create request is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new
                owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same
                household (same householdId) with different telephones have
                different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

## What I did

**Extracted `Owner`'s derived read-only attribute computations into a new package-private `OwnerDerivations` helper** (pure `static` functions — the same idiom the codebase already uses for `luhnCheckDigit`, `sha256Hex8`, `toE164`), leaving `Owner`'s `@Transient` getters as thin delegators:

| `Owner` getter (unchanged signature) | now delegates to |
|---|---|
| `getLocality()` | `OwnerDerivations.locality(...)` |

| `getMembershipLevel()` | `OwnerDerivations.membershipLevel(...)` |
| `getContactPreference()` | `OwnerDerivations.contactPreference(...)` |
| `getCheckDigit()` | `OwnerDerivations.checkDigit(...)` |

The `CITY_REGION`/`REGION_POSTCODES` tables and the `regionForPostcode`/`luhnCheckDigit` helpers moved with them. Field normalization and household-matching behavior (`normalizeAddress`, `sameHouseholdAs`, `householdKey`) stayed on `Owner`, since those are create-time entity behavior rather than DTO-facing derived attributes.

The upcoming `ageBand` is a sixth derived read-only attribute (carrying real date math) joining `locality`/`membershipLevel`/`contactPreference`/`checkDigit`/`identityKey` — the exact pile that had accumulated inline in an already-large `Owner`. With that pile now living together behind thin delegators, the change lands as a small, idiomatic insertion:

- `getBirthDate()`/`setBirthDate()` — plain accessors next to `registrationDate` (mirroring `Pet.birthDate`);
- `getAgeBand()` — a one-line `@Transient` delegator to a new `OwnerDerivations.ageBand(birthDate, registrationDate)`, sitting alongside its peers.

No public signatures changed, so the controller, MapStruct mapper, and OpenAPI contract are untouched.

I deliberately did **not** implement the feature, per the instructions, so that expected red remains. No previously-passing behavior regressed — confirmed by the identical DTO output above.
